title: Reimbursement of Work Done Outside the Workshop Network, Keyturn Vehicle Care Plan
content:
Where work on a vehicle held on the Keyturn Vehicle Care Plan is done at a workshop outside the network, the plan reimburses a share of the invoice up to a ceiling on that one visit. Both figures are set by the plan, and two of the plans reimburse nothing at all.

| Plan | Share of the invoice reimbursed (percent) | Ceiling on one out-of-network visit (USD) |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Keyturn Care Essentials Plan | 0 | 0.00 |
| Keyturn Care Routine Plan | 50 | 150.00 |
| Keyturn Care Complete Plan | 70 | 350.00 |
| Keyturn Care Turnaround Plan | 75 | 500.00 |
| Keyturn Care Fleet Plan | 80 | 750.00 |
| Keyturn Care Electric Plan | 65 | 450.00 |

### The same schedule in words

A vehicle on the Keyturn Care Essentials Plan carries a share of 0 percent and a ceiling of 0.00, which is to say the plan does not reimburse out-of-network work at all. On the Keyturn Care Routine Plan the share is half the invoice and the ceiling on a single visit is 150.00; on the Keyturn Care Complete Plan, seventy percent and 350.00; on the Keyturn Care Turnaround Plan, three quarters and 500.00; on the Keyturn Care Fleet Plan, eighty percent and 750.00; and on the Keyturn Care Electric Plan, sixty-five percent and 450.00.

The plan carrying the largest share of the invoice, the Keyturn Care Fleet Plan at 80 percent, also carries the largest ceiling on one visit at 750.00. The two figures do not otherwise rank alike: the Keyturn Care Electric Plan reimburses a smaller share than the Keyturn Care Complete Plan, 65 percent against 70, and yet carries the larger ceiling, 450.00 against 350.00.
